prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1440; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the left quarter panel creased near the taillight, and the trunk lid shows a shallow dent consistent with the reported impact. Some of the lower reinforcement damage could have come from this collision, but it is not clear whether all of it did, so the plan keeps those items flagged for a closer look once the panels are removed. The repair labor hours fit the damage described, and the plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, straightening the quarter panel, and refinishing the affected areas. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the file. The bills submitted show no repeated charges for the same work.
